Analysis at NHSBSA runs through five phases, and then round again. The picture below is the whole
of it on one page. Underneath it, each phase has a button that goes straight to what that phase
asks of you.

## What runs through all five

Two things are not phases, and both of them run from the first to the last.

**Quality assurance.** It is planned in Phase 1, designed in Phase 2, done in Phase 3, stated in
Phase 4 and tested in Phase 5. [Deciding your assurance
level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) sets out how much of it your work needs.

**Customer and stakeholder engagement.** The commissioner states the decision in Phase 1, approves
the design in Phase 2, stays available in Phase 3, confirms the work meets their need in Phase 4,
and asks in Phase 5 whether it informed the decision. [Roles and
responsibilities](../06-roles/index.qmd) sets out who else has a part, and leads to a page
for each of them.
